tokenizer_seam: Reserved multimodal tokens remain in tokenizer.json, but public inference code consumes only input_ids and does not implement image-to-embedding injection.
interpretation: The release contains a multimodal-looking tokenizer seam without a public vision tower/projector or image injection path. A hidden training-time visual route is possible but not observable from the released runtime; real-weight receiver-prior and backward gates remain mandatory.
limitations: code audit covers the public inference subpackage, not private training code
absence of symbols does not prove no historical multimodal training
full weights were not loaded on V100
